record.question: Which one of the following statements is correct in respect of BJT?
options: Avalanche multiplication starts when the reverse biased collector-base voltage VCB equals the avalanche breakdown voltage BVCBO.
The early effect starts as soon as punch through occurs in a transistor.
The small signal current gain hfe=large signal current gain hFE when IC → 0.
In the CE mode, a transistor can be cut off by reducing IB to zero.
